description: Search DatasheetVend's component library: parts from dozens of manufacturers whose manufacturer datasheet DatasheetVend stores. Search by part number, vendor, package, architecture or application words (for example 'STM32 QFN', 'ESP32', 'BLE wearable', 'Cortex-M4'), optionally filtered by vendor, package family, category, pin range or Verified Pack. Each result gives the part page, the stored datasheet PDF (often a family datasheet covering several ordering codes), the manufacturer's own URL when known, whether a curated Verified Pack exists, and the address of the part-pack manifest (a lookup that may answer 'no shelved pack'). A result is a stored datasheet, not extracted data: to extract it, pass its datasheet_pdf_url to an extraction tool. Any one search word can match a row; results are ranked, paged with offset, and do not report a total. Free, no API key, no model call.

category.description: Part category as the library page files it.

package_family.description: Package family as the library page groups them.

pin_range.description: low: up to 16 pins; mid: 17-64; high: 65-144; extreme: 145 or more.

query.description: Search words: part number, vendor, package, architecture or application, separated by spaces.

vendor.description: Vendor slug such as 'stmicroelectronics' or 'espressif', or part of the vendor's name.

verified_pack_only.description: Only parts that have a curated Verified Pack.
